Southeast Fencing & Gates — pricing, updated August 2026

All prices below INCLUDE GST. We're based in Berwick and we travel up to 30km from there, which
covers Beaconsfield, Officer, Pakenham, Narre Warren, Clyde, Cranbourne, Hampton Park, Hallam,
Endeavour Hills and Doveton. We don't go into the CBD or down the peninsula.

Minimum charge is $850 for any job. Below that it's not worth us bringing the truck and crew out,
so if it's a small repair we'd rather tell you honestly than pad the quote.

TREATED PINE PALING (our most common job)
0.9m high — $62 per metre
1.2m high — $71 per metre
1.5m high — $79 per metre
1.8m high — $85 per metre
2.1m high — $104 per metre

MERBAU / HARDWOOD PALING
1.5m high — $118 per metre
1.8m high — $132 per metre
2.1m high — $158 per metre

COLORBOND
1.2m high — $88 per metre
1.5m high — $96 per metre
1.8m high — $110 per metre
2.1m high — $128 per metre
Colour range is standard Colorbond, no extra charge for colour choice.

ALUMINIUM SLAT
1.2m high — $165 per metre
1.5m high — $184 per metre
1.8m high — $210 per metre

POOL FENCING (flat top aluminium, AS 1926.1 compliant)
1.2m high — $195 per metre
1.35m high — $215 per metre
A pool compliance inspection and certificate is NOT included in the above — that's $290 extra and
we organise the inspector for you. We won't hand over a pool fence without it being done properly.

CHAINMESH / SECURITY
1.8m high — $74 per metre
2.4m high — $92 per metre

RURAL / POST AND WIRE
1.2m high, 5 wire — $38 per metre
Minimum 100m run for rural work, otherwise our travel makes it uneconomical for you.

REMOVAL OF EXISTING FENCE
$18 per metre to pull down and cart away an old timber fence.
$24 per metre for an old Colorbond or metal fence.
This is charged SEPARATELY and on top of the supply-and-install rate above. So a 30 metre 1.8m pine
fence replacing an old timber one is $85 per metre plus $18 per metre for the removal.

GATES (priced per gate, not per metre)
Single pedestrian gate, timber, up to 1.2m wide — $480
Single pedestrian gate, Colorbond — $520
Double / driveway gate, timber, up to 3.6m — $1,340
Double / driveway gate, Colorbond, up to 3.6m — $1,480
Sliding driveway gate, aluminium — $2,650
Gate motor supply and install — $1,450 per motor, includes the power run up to 10m.

SITE CONDITIONS THAT CHANGE THE PRICE
Sloped or stepped blocks — add $14 per metre, because we step the panels and it's slower.
Rock or hand-dig only where the machine can't get in — add $22 per metre.
Restricted access, e.g. no side gate and everything carried through the house — add $9 per metre.
We'll always tell you at the measure-up if any of these apply. We don't spring them on you later.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Site inspection and measure-up, all standard materials and fixings, concrete footings, standard
excavation, installation, clean-up and removal of our own rubbish. Posts go 700mm deep at 2.4m
centres as standard.

WHAT'S NOT INCLUDED
Council permits, engineering drawings, asbestos handling, relocating services, tree or stump removal,
landscaping, painting or staining, and pool compliance certification (priced above).

We do custom gates and we're happy to work on steep blocks — a lot of mobs won't. 20 years in the
south-east, fully insured, and we do our own installs rather than subbing out.
